This horror is scripted. Your goosebumps are not.
A woman murders her sexist husband and turns his corpse into a puppet of the perfect man.
"Bill" by Emily Dhue
Connect with the Filmmakers:
More About "Bill":
Lilith prepares dinner for her husband Bill, but his relentless misogynistic comments push her to a breaking point, stabbing him to death in a sudden outburst. Manic, she attempts to revive him by turning him into a puppet-like figure to possess, eventually going out for drinks in his silent company; meanwhile, despite the evident circumstances, the waiter hands the corpse the bill.
